question.text: Consider the function $f: \mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ defined by $f(x)=\frac{2 x}{\sqrt{1+9 x^2}}$. If the composition of $f, \underbrace{(f \circ f \circ f \circ \cdots \circ f)}_{10 \text { times }}(x)=\frac{2^{10} x}{\sqrt{1+9 \alpha x^2}}$, then the value of $\sqrt{3 \alpha+1}$ is equal to ______
